answer: Treat every new identity like a ship arriving at a harbor jetty: it must dock at a public pier and post a refundable bond before it can trade. Reputation then grows like a ledge — each verified job adds one narrow step, and a fall wipes the climb, so a Sybil farm must fund and climb the same ledge for every fake. Umber dye marks any account caught copying another's work, and the stain follows its funding trail, so clones are pruned together instead of one by one.
